imageCaption: You own the storefront, the customer list, the order history, and the wallet. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

content.text: Every platform account you depend on is a risk you are carrying on someone else's terms. PayPal can freeze your balance with no warning and hold it for 180 days. Stripe can reject your application because your country is on an internal risk list they will never show you. Gumroad can suspend your store because an algorithm flagged your content category. These events happen to thousands of [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-keeps|COREMERCH guide to creators]] every month — disproportionately in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Kenya, Ethiopia, and other markets that conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-everything-you-need|Payment Options]] platforms treat as high-risk by default. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-honest-side-side-3|sovereign]] infrastructure means the storefront code is in your GitHub or Cloudflare account. The customer list is in your Supabase database or Google Sheet. The order history is exportable as CSV at any time. The product files are in your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The wallet addresses and all funds were never touched by anyone else. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provide a comprehensive infrastructure solution for digital creators. The Sovereign Starter Stack includes GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, while the Edge Commerce Stack adds Supabase for order storage and Google Drive for file delivery. Both options also include 30-day support, ensuring that creators can troubleshoot any issues that may arise. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides complete documentation for all five stacks, including NOWPayments integration guides and scaling playbooks. This comprehensive solution empowers creators to build, deploy, and scale their digital commerce infrastructure with confidence.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to bypass country restrictions, ensuring that digital creators can process payments and manage orders without being locked out of their accounts. By using crypto payment processing through NOWPayments, creators can accept payments in 300+ cryptocurrencies, eliminating the need for traditional payment gateways that are often restricted in certain countries. This means that creators can focus on selling their digital products without worrying about being blocked by restrictive payment platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

COREMERCH's payment processing solution through NOWPayments offers fast transaction times, with most transactions processing in under 10 seconds. The fees are also competitive, with a flat fee of 0.5% per transaction, making it an attractive option for digital creators who want to maximize their revenue. Additionally, the recommended networks for low fees, such as BSC, Solana, and TRON, offer transaction fees as low as $0.10 per transaction, making it an affordable option for creators who want to sell their digital products without breaking the bank.
COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers digital creators to own their store's backend, eliminating the risk of platform suspension or account freezing.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers digital creators to own their store's backend, ensuring that they have complete control over their digital product delivery and order management. The automation features through Cloudflare Workers and Supabase ensure that orders are processed quickly and efficiently, reducing the risk of human error and increasing customer satisfaction. Additionally, the use of Google Drive and Cloudflare R2 for file delivery ensures that digital products are delivered securely and reliably, giving creators peace of mind knowing that their customers will receive their products on time.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice between COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack depends on the creator's specific needs and goals. The Sovereign Starter Stack is ideal for creators who want a simple and cost-effective solution for processing payments and managing orders, while the Edge Commerce Stack is better suited for creators who want a more comprehensive solution with additional features such as order storage and file delivery. Additionally, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides everything creators need to build, deploy, and scale their sovereign digital commerce stack, including all six blueprints and seven templates, making it an attractive option for creators who want to take their digital commerce to the next level.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

The most important question a digital creator should ask is: 'Can I own my store's backend and process payments without relying on third-party services that can freeze my account or suspend my services?' The answer is yes, with COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure. By leveraging the power of Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, creators can build, deploy, and scale their digital commerce infrastructure with confidence, eliminating the risk of platform suspension or account freezing.

By using NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, creators can accept payments in 300+ cryptocurrencies, bypassing traditional payment gateways that are often restricted in certain countries.

For digital creators who want to learn more about building, deploying, and scaling their sovereign digital commerce stack, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is a comprehensive solution that includes all six blueprints and seven templates, making it an attractive option for creators who want to take their digital commerce to the next level. Additionally, COREMERCH offers a range of products and services, including the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), Edge Commerce Stack ($197), and Sovereign Blueprint ($47), that can help creators achieve their goals. To learn more, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can follow these steps: Choose the right stack for their needs, either the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack; Set up their GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting; Configure their Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic; Integrate their NOWPayments account for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification; Set up their Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage; and configure their Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. With these steps, creators can build, deploy, and scale their digital commerce infrastructure with confidence.

No, COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to bypass traditional payment gateways such as Stripe and PayPal, which are often restricted in certain countries. Instead, creators can use NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification.

Yes, COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed with security in mind, using decentralized and open-source technologies to protect creators' data and prevent platform suspension or account freezing.
Can I scale my COREMERCH sovereign commerce infrastructure?
